title: Functional Multi-Target Detection via Bispectrum Inversion
summary: This paper develops a functional theory for multi-target detection, where a compactly supported signal is recovered from a single noisy observation containing many unknown translations of the signal. Our formulation allows continuous, off-grid translations and correlated stationary Gaussian process noise, extending beyond the discrete, grid-aligned, white-noise models common in prior work.
